amendment_reason: The first V7 free quote failed all-or-nothing after 453 seconds when one metadata.get_billable_size call returned HTTP 504. This is a no-cost transient source-infrastructure error. Add bounded, auditable retries only for free metadata endpoints; never extend retry authority to paid time-series or batch calls.
required_behavior: Retry only metadata.get_cost and metadata.get_billable_size for explicitly classified transient HTTP 429, 502, 503, 504, timeout or connection errors.
Maximum three attempts per endpoint call: one initial attempt plus two retries, with bounded backoff. Permanent/auth/schema errors fail immediately.
Count and persist every free metadata attempt by method; require at least 630 and at most 1890 attempts for each per-window method, while quote coverage remains exactly 630 unique canonical windows.
Dataset-range and symbology remain single-attempt unless separately amended. Paid timeseries.get_range and batch methods remain zero during quote and retain no automatic retry under download.
red_first_acceptance_tests: A transient 504 on get_billable_size succeeds on retry and receipt counters expose the extra attempt.
A permanent error fails without retry.
Three transient failures exhaust the bound and fail without plan/receipt mutation.
No test path calls or retries timeseries.get_range.
All prior 29 tests remain green and the offline plan is regenerated with final tool SHA and deterministic plan ID.
prohibitions: Do not call any remote endpoint while implementing or testing V8.
Do not add automatic retry to paid time-series or batch operations.
Do not modify registry, preregistration, event clock, strategy logic, docs, MQL5, MT5 or unrelated files.
Do not stage, commit, push, create a branch, worktree or clone.
